@graph.name: Nikol Pavlova
@graph.description: Nikol Pavlova is a professional English- and Czech-speaking makeup artist based in Prague, teaching personalised one-on-one makeup courses alongside bridal, evening and commercial work.

mainEntity.name: Who are the makeup courses in Prague suitable for?

acceptedAnswer.text: The courses suit everyone – from complete beginners who want to learn everyday makeup for themselves, to people preparing for a special occasion, to aspiring makeup artists building professional skills. Each course is personalised to your level and goals.

mainEntity.name: What does a makeup course with Nikol Pavlova cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Courses are one-on-one sessions covering skin preparation, colour theory, foundation and base techniques, eye makeup and lashes, contour and highlight, plus tool and product selection. We work using your own face as the canvas so you can repeat the looks at home.

mainEntity.name: Are the makeup lessons one-on-one or in a group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lessons are personalised one-on-one sessions tailored to your skill level and goals, so the full session focuses entirely on you. Small private group sessions can be arranged on request.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to bring my own makeup products to the course?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can come with your existing products so we can work with what you already own and recommend improvements, or use professional products during the lesson. After the session you receive a personalised product and tool list.

mainEntity.name: Are the makeup courses available in English?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Nikol teaches in fluent English and Czech, making the courses comfortable for international clients and expats living in Prague.

mainEntity.name: How do I book a makeup course in Prague?

acceptedAnswer.text: Book online via the Calendly scheduling page at https://calendly.com/pavlovanikol/makeup-hair, or contact Nikol by phone +420 608 178 390, email pavlovanikol@gmail.com, or Instagram @nikol__mua.
